content: Indication-specific dosing for Kriaxanthin Antarctic Krill Oil and Neptune Krill Oil (krill oil) includes detailed guidelines for use, adverse effects based on frequency, comprehensive drug or condition interactions, contraindications, pregnancy and lactation considerations, and cost information. A dosage of 5 grams per day has been utilized in studies investigating its effects on hyperlipidemia. Krill oil has been studied for its potential benefits in managing hyperlipidemia, premenstrual syndrome (PMS), dysmenorrhea, and arthritis. It is contraindicated in individuals with shellfish allergies and those with coagulation disorders. Pregnancy category information is not available (N/A). Similarly, lactation safety data is not available (N/A). In general, krill oil is considered acceptable for use. Controlled studies conducted in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk.
